verdict.rationale: turbopuffer documents its own deletion controls: conditional deletes, deleting a document only if a condition holds, and delete-by-filter for removing all documents that match a filter. That covers the deletion half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows retention control, and no independent source confirms deletion actually purges data. missing for 10: retention policies/TTL or automatic expiry, documented namespace deletion, guarantees on purge from object storage/backups/WAL, independent corroboration.
